'''離'''（り）は[[八卦]]の一つ。卦の形は[[画像:Ri_.png]]であり、初[[爻]]は[[陰陽思想|陽]]、第2爻は陰、第3爻は陽で構成される。または[[六十四卦]]の一つであり、離為火。離上離下で構成される。
== 卦象 == [[火]]・麗・[[雉]]・[[目]]・中女などを象徴する。[[方位]]としては[[南]]を示す。
[[Category:易|り]]

== 卦象 == 外側に陽剛の卦、内側に陰柔の卦がある。原義は「一見明るいが中は暗い」。また「二つのものが一つをはさんで向かい合う」である。即ち[[火]]・光・稲妻（[[雷]]の光）・麗・[[雉]]・[[目]]・[[心臓]]・[[乳房]]・喜び·華やかさ・中女・別離対立・紛争・外見・赤(紫)色などを象徴する。[[方位]]としては[[南]]（[[地支]]では[[午]]）を示す。
[[納甲]]では[[己]]、[[五行思想|五行]]の[[土]]、[[五方]]の[[中]]が当てられる。
== 先天図 == 伏羲先天八卦における次序は三であり、方位は四正卦の一つで[[東]]に配される。陰陽消息は二陽で[[震]]卦に次ぐ。

{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries}} {{Cite source|date=December 2018}} {{color}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|ja|魔方陣}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}} ({{ill|wood|ja|木}}, {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|earth|ja|土}}, {{ill|metal|ja|金}}, and {{ill|water|ja|水}}), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|ja|十干}}, the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|ja|十二支}}, and the {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}} of {{ill|I Ching|ja|易経}}. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|ja|禹}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|ja|洛書}}), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|ja|河図洛書}}.
== The Nine Stars == In Japanese {{ill|Onmyōdō|ja|陰陽道}}, the following table associates the Nine Stars with the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}}, {{ill|directions|ja|方位}}, {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}}, and colors, forming the '''Nine Stars Chart''' used to predict {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}} and the {{ill|auspiciousness|ja|吉凶}} of directions based on a person's birth year.
{| class="wikitable" |- ! Star ! Reading ! Five Element ! Direction ! Eight Trigram ! Color |- ! {{ill|First White Water Star|ja|一白水星}} | Ippaku Suisei | Water | {{ill|North|ja|北}} | {{ill|Kan|ja|坎}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Second Black Earth Star|ja|二黒土星}} | Jikoku Dosei | Earth | Southwest | {{ill|Kun|ja|坤}} | style="background:black;color:white;"| Black |- ! {{ill|Third Blue Wood Star|ja|三碧木星}} | Sanpeki Mokusei | Wood | {{ill|East|ja|東}} | {{ill|Zhen|ja|震}} | style="background:blue;color:white;"| Blue |- ! {{ill|Fourth Green Wood Star|ja|四緑木星}} | Shiroku Mokusei | Wood | Southeast | {{ill|Xun|ja|巽}} | style="background:green;color:white;"| Green |- ! {{ill|Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} | Goō Dosei | Earth | Center | {{ill|Tai Chi|ja|太極}} | style="background:yellow;"| Yellow |- ! {{ill|Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} | Roppaku Kinsei | Metal | Northwest | {{ill|Qian|ja|乾}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} | Shichiseki Kinsei | Metal | {{ill|West|ja|西}} | {{ill|Dui|ja|兌}} | style="background:red;color:white;"| Red |- ! {{ill|Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} | Happaku Dosei | Earth | Northeast | {{ill|Gen|ja|艮}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} | Kyūshi Kasei | Fire | {{ill|South|ja|南}} | {{ill|Li|ja|離}} | style="background:purple;color:white;"| Purple |}
Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the {{ill|Solar System|ja|太陽系}}.
== Relationships Among the Stars == The relationships among the Nine Stars follow the {{ill|five elements theory|ja|五行思想}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- ! Star ! Beneficial (Compatible) ! Neutral (Compatible) ! Harmful (Incompatible) |- ! First White Water Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star | First White Water Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star |- ! Second Black Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Third Blue Wood Star | First White Water Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Eighth White Earth Star |- ! Fourth Green Wood Star | First White Water Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Eighth White Earth Star |- ! Fifth Yellow Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Sixth White Metal Star | First White Water Star, Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star |- ! Seventh Red Metal Star | First White Water Star, Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star |- ! Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Ninth Purple Fire Star | First White Water Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star |}
These relationships are used for predicting {{ill|compatibility|ja|相性}}, {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}}, and {{ill|auspicious directions|ja|吉方位}}.

{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries]] {{Cite source|date=December 2018]] {| class="wikitable" |- | {{ill|Li|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:離]] |}{{color]] '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:九星]], Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:魔方陣]]:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:後天定位盤]]), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:五行思想]] ({{ill|wood|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:木]], {{ill|fire|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:火]], {{ill|earth|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:土]], {{ill|metal|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:金]], and {{ill|water|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:水]]), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:十干]], the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:十二支]], and the {{ill|eight trigrams|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:八卦]] of {{ill|I Ching|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:易経]]. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:禹]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:夏王朝]], conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:洛水]]. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:洛書]]), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:河図洛書]].

Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the {{ill|Solar System|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:太陽系]].

These relationships are used for predicting {{ill|compatibility|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:相性]], {{ill|fortune|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:運勢]], and {{ill|auspicious directions|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:吉方位]].

{{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen (☳)|ja|震}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Ri''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Ri below and Ri above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Ri symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Ri is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Ri is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

revision.text:
{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

revision.text:
{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

{{Bagua}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|light|ja|光}}, {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻}} (the light of {{ill|thunder|ja|雷}}), beauty, {{ill|pheasants|ja|雉}}, {{ill|eyes|ja|目}}, {{ill|the heart|ja|心臓}}, {{ill|breasts|ja|乳房}}, joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|south|ja|南}}<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)}}, the Earth element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the {{ill|east|ja|東}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}} trigram.

revision.text:
{{八卦}} '''離'''（り）は[[八卦]]の一つ。卦の形は{{resize|125%|'''☲'''}}であり、初[[爻]]は[[陽]]、第2爻は陰、第3爻は陽で構成される。または[[六十四卦]]の一つであり、[[周易上経三十卦の一覧#離|離為火]]。離下離上で構成される。
== 卦象 == 外側に陽剛の卦、内側に陰柔の卦がある。原義は「一見明るいが中は暗い」。また「二つのものが一つをはさんで向かい合う」である。即ち[[火]]・光・稲妻（[[雷]]の光）・麗・[[雉]]・[[目]]・[[心臓]]・[[乳房]]・喜び·華やかさ・中女・別離対立・紛争・外見・赤（紫）色などを象徴する。[[方位]]としては[[南]]を示す<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」国立国会図書館 2021年12月16日閲覧</ref>（[[地支]]では[[午]]と一致）。
[[納甲]]では[[己]]、[[五行思想|五行]]の[[土]]、[[五方]]の[[中]]が当てられる。
== 先天図 == 伏羲先天八卦における次序は三であり、方位は四正卦の一つで[[東]]に配される。陰陽消息は二陽で[[震]]卦に次ぐ。
== 脚注 == {{Reflist}}
{{DEFAULTSORT:り}} [[Category:易]]

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction|2=ja|3=方位|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction|2=ja|3=方位|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction|2=ja|3=方位|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction|2=ja|3=方位|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction|2=ja|3=方位|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Five Directions|13=User:Immanuelle/Cardinal direction|qq=}}.
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.
