{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Li (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q3272087]] Wikidata name: lí [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:51, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Li''' (離) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☲'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yang (⚊), the second being Yin (⚋), and the third being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Li as Fire|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li為火|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li as Fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Li below and Li above.
== Trigram Symbolism == The outer part of the trigram is Yang and strong, while the inner part is Yin and gentle. The original meaning is "outwardly bright but dark within." It also represents "two things facing each other with one in between." Li symbolizes {{ill|fire|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|1=Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/fire|13=User:Immanuelle/Fire (wuxing)|ja|Fire (火)|1=Fire (wuxing)|lt=Fire (火)|2=uk|3=Вогонь (У-сін)|4=bcl|5=Kalayo (wuxing)|6=pt|7=Fogo (astrologia)|8=vi|9=Hỏa (Ngũ hành)|10=ar|11=النار (وو شينغ)|lt=Fire (火)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, [[:en:Light|light]], {{ill|lightning|ja|稲妻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lightning|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 雷}} (the light of [[:en:Lightning|thunder]]), beauty, [[:en:Kiji|pheasants]], [[:en:Eye|eyes]], [[:en:Heart|the heart]], [[:en:Breast|breasts]], joy, splendor, middle-aged women, separation and opposition, conflict, appearance, and the colors red or purple. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the [[:en:South|south]]<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref> and corresponds to {{ill|Wu (午)|ja|午|1=Horse (Zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|2=ja|3=午|1=Horse (zodiac)|lt=Horse (午)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wu (午)|13=User:Immanuelle/Horse (Zodiac)|qq=}} in the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|地支|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Earthly Branches|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 十二支}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Li is associated with {{ill|Ji (己)|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji (己)|13=User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|qq=}}, the Earth element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the center among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Li is the third in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing the [[:en:East|east]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it has two Yang lines and follows the {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}} trigram.
